name: gitactionsview
description: GitActionsView - Chronological GitHub Actions run log

scripts.start: npm run build --prefix frontend && mkdir -p backend/public && cp -r frontend/dist/* backend/public/ && (node --env-file=.env backend/src/index.js > backend.log 2>&1 &) && echo 'Started — log: backend.log'
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "node --env-file=.env --watch backend/src/index.js" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.docker: docker build -t gitactionsview . && docker run -d -p 9000:9000 --env-file .env -v ./data:/app/data --name gitactionsview gitactionsview
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.test: cd backend && npm test && cd ../frontend && npm test
